label: Topcoder
terms_note: Public challenge list (anonymous); member actions (register, submit) need a Topcoder JWT and their docs were unreachable — UI actions until documented. Policy page: no automation clause matched.

discovery.auth: none for the challenge list (JWT for member endpoints, undocumented)

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit published (docs.topcoder.com unreachable; the API overview article is a 404). Two requests per second.

search_postings.note: Live public endpoint (no reachable reference page — confidence medium): `GET /v6/challenges?status=Active&page=&perPage=`; status=Active is fixed. No documented keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. The response is a bare array; the total comes only in X-Total / X-Total-Pages headers the runtime does not read, so `total` is null and `next_page` is derived from the page size. `budget_max`/`currency` are the first prize of the first prizeSet (prizeSets[0].prizes[0].value/type); `description` is markdown; phases, track, type, numOfRegistrants and numOfSubmissions stay in `raw`.

get_posting.note: `GET /v6/challenges/{id}` (challenge UUID) returns the full challenge spec; same mapping as search_postings.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'Registration / submission are UI actions until member APIs are documented' (member endpoints need a Topcoder JWT; docs unreachable).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
